notes: Adds missing API layer, core enforcement logic, and test coverage for consent workflow.

change_log.note: Adds core logic layer missing for runtime enforcement
Adds API exposure for consent operations
Adds test coverage for compliance-critical flows

stories.title: Consent Enforcement Engine
stories.description: Implement core logic to enforce consent tiers at runtime, ensuring all downstream services (lead capture, unknown question logging, debug logging) respect Tier 1 vs Tier 2 rules for PII storage and de-identification.

stories.title: Consent API and Tool Router Integration
stories.description: Expose consent operations (create, upgrade to Tier 2, revoke) via FastAPI endpoints and integrate with tool_router to allow LLM-triggered consent flows with validated inputs.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering consent creation, tier transitions, enforcement behavior, audit logging, and lead capture integration to ensure HIPAA-compliant handling of PII.

per_feature.mitigation: Enforce strict unit and integration test coverage for all consent transitions and PII handling paths.
